agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Turns 9-13 left Croakatoa against healing Dustox for four Mud Shots and Vacuum Wave; Dustox fell only from 52 to 42 while Croakatoa fell from 44 to 0 without fulfilling its Sunflora role.

resolution.observed: Reloaded turn 9 with behavior 43e751d3: Birdlaw entered immediately, dealt 44 verified damage with two Aerial Aces, forced Ohmnomnom entered without a hit, and faster Spark guaranteed and executed the KO. Croakatoa stayed 44/44 and Bushtank stayed 57/57 for Eelektrik.

findings.why_bad: A scoring dimension intended only for endangered actions accidentally made any safe weak attack outrank the stronger safe matchup switch.
findings.improvement: Pre-KO action priority now applies only when an action is unsafe; safe attacks and safe switches compare their actual matchup progress.
findings.next_test: Require the direct Birdlaw-Dustox handoff and preserved Croakatoa in the next full clone.

findings.summary: The win took 28 actions, including five low-impact Croakatoa actions into Black Sludge recovery; the corrected bounded line removes those turns.
findings.next_test: Compare action count and Dustox turns in the next clone.

findings.summary: Bushtank and Coppertop fainted, but both dealt verified Eelektrik damage before forced replacements; these were progress-making sacrifices rather than switch stalls.
findings.next_test: Retain only if the corrected Dustox line still reaches Sunflora with a reliable finisher.

correct_choices: The battle was won authoritatively in 28 verified actions.
Only turns 3 and 17 were voluntary switches; both entered above the verified critical-survival bound and immediately enabled matchup damage.
Turns 7, 14, 21, and 25 were forced replacements after verified faints, not switch spam.
Lildozer used priority Ice Shard before its intentional faint, and Birdlaw used Quick Attack to finish 2-HP Eelektrik before removing Sunflora with two Aerial Aces.
No immediate reversal, consecutive voluntary switch, unsafe voluntary switch, hidden extra input, or execution mismatch occurred.
agent_review.next_test: Run clone 1 again with unchanged behavior 43e751d3; qualification remains zero because this reviewed win contained a confirmed high-severity suboptimal line.
